name: Messages Improved
description:
This tweak adds iMessage support to the Messages app. It also improves MMS by making the messages go directly to the group chat. It also makes the app super fast and responsive.

| Measured | Stock | Improved |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| App cold start | 1.3 s | 0.85 s |
| MMS notification, no unread | 1.0 s | 0.87 s |
| MMS notification, 12 unread | 1.6 s | 0.9 s |
| Opening a 387-message group chat | 7.7 s | 2.4 s |
author: thooton

changes.text: Release MMS process binding on teardown.
Revise catalog descriptions and retire Book Recs.
Show iMessage files as cards (icon, name, size).
Download iMessage file attachments (PDFs, zips, ...) on demand.
Keep video playback fullscreen without status bar on open, pause/OK, and menu.
Fix RowTextView scroll crash, sent photo inline style, attachment-exit scroll position, and photo fullscreen-before-zoom.
Ship-time AOT + rcs_service_api.jar precompile, cold conversation open deferrals and warm-up.
Batch inbox recipient prefetch, off-main E.164/ICU warm-up, deferred secondary inbox queries, rounded avatar cache, inbox row bind micro-opts.
Strip MIME parameters and allow application/ogg in iMessage media routing.
